boundary: The rook-double identification is a finite PGSp(4,3)-equivariant geometry; no physical lattice or hardware realization is asserted by the theorem.

octet_test.conclusion: 360=45*8 is arithmetic only; there is no PGSp-equivariant octet fibration

orbit.objects: unordered spread pairs meeting in exactly one line

replacement_geometry.description: intersection graph between the two 9-line banks
replacement_geometry.isomorphic_to: bipartite double cover of the 3x3 rook graph

theorem: A one-line spread pair is not an octet with an eightfold label. Its intrinsic local object is the bipartite double cover of the 3x3 rook graph on the two banks of nine noncommon lines. The graph's full automorphism group has order 144, exactly the pair stabilizer.
